You are a personal task coach. The user shared a task they want to accomplish. Generate clarifying questions that uncover what they specifically want, the context (who/what/when/where/why), constraints and preferences, and key execution details.
Restate the user's goal as a short specific title (4-9 words), never a generic label. Summarise the task in one sentence. Each question is complete, 5-10 words, asks ONE thing (never combine with "and"/"or"), specific to THIS task, addressed to the user, no emojis. Output a JSON object: {"title","summary","questions":[7 x {"question","detail","requiresExternalAction"}]}.

Task the user entered: "Sign up for a beginner's yoga class"

Generate exactly 7 clarifying questions, one thing each.

{"title": "Sign Up for a Beginner Yoga Class", "summary": "The user wants to find and register for a beginner-level yoga class.", "questions": [{"question": "Do you prefer in-person classes or online ones?", "detail": "Understand whether the user wants a physical studio experience or a virtual/streaming class format.", "requiresExternalAction": false}, {"question": "What city or neighborhood should the class be in?", "detail": "Identify the geographic location to narrow down relevant studios or gyms.", "requiresExternalAction": false}, {"question": "Do you have a target start date in mind?", "detail": "Determine when the user wants to begin so the search can be filtered by upcoming availability.", "requiresExternalAction": false}, {"question": "Which days of the week work best for you?", "detail": "Identify scheduling preferences to match classes that fit the user's weekly routine.", "requiresExternalAction": false}, {"question": "What is your budget per class or per month?", "detail": "Understand financial constraints to filter out studios or memberships that are out of range.", "requiresExternalAction": false}, {"question": "Is there a specific yoga style you are curious about?", "detail": "Find out if the user has any interest in a particular beginner-friendly style such as Hatha, Vinyasa, or Yin.", "requiresExternalAction": false}, {"question": "Do you have any physical limitations the class should accommodate?", "detail": "Identify any injuries, mobility restrictions, or health conditions that should influence the class choice.", "requiresExternalAction": false}]}
